claim: Open-source project management tool for issues, cycles, modules, views, pages and analytics
Built with React Router, Django and Node
Installation methods: Docker, Kubernetes, managed hosting; Plane Cloud also exists
Install menu lists Docker Compose, Docker AIO, Swarm, Kubernetes, Podman Quadlets, Coolify and Portainer
Community Edition under AGPL v3.0, equal to Cloud Free tier; paid plans require switching to Commercial Edition; Commercial gives 12 free seats per workspace
Commercial Docker Compose guide: 2 cores, 4GB RAM, 8GB recommended for production
A Pro, Business or Enterprise Grid license key unlocks paid features
Instance admins configure settings with God mode
